name: Boston ether surgical anaesthesia demonstration
description: At Massachusetts General Hospital, William Morton publicly demonstrated ether anaesthesia in a surgical setting.

impact.note: A single demonstration, yet surgical anaesthesia spread across continents within a year from it, reorganised surgery, and anaesthesiology grew from it.

date.label: 16 October 1846

evidence.supports: The hospital historical account dates the public demonstration to 16 October 1846 and notes earlier dental applications.

events.caveats: This was not the first use of pain relief or anaesthesia; the retrospective does not resolve disputes about earlier contributions.
